scheme: Walk-forward, expanding window, refit yearly; target = next-week direction

features.label: 1-week return
features.description: Percent change in adjusted close over the last week.

features.label: 4-week return
features.description: Percent change in adjusted close over the last 4 weeks.

features.label: 12-week return
features.description: Percent change in adjusted close over the last 12 weeks.

features.label: 20-day volatility
features.description: Annualised standard deviation of daily returns over 20 trading days.

features.label: RSI (14 days)
features.description: Relative strength index over 14 trading days.

features.label: Distance from 50-day average
features.description: Percent gap between close and its 50-day moving average.

features.label: Volume ratio
features.description: Last week's average volume divided by the 12-week average.

features.label: KMI-30 4-week return
features.description: Index return over the last 4 weeks.

features.label: 12-week return vs KMI-30
features.description: Symbol 12-week return minus the index 12-week return.

features.label: Policy rate change (12 weeks)
features.description: Change in the SBP policy rate over 12 weeks, by release date.

limitations: DEMO fixture: every number on this card is synthetic.
Accuracy is only a few points above the baselines; treat the output as one signal among several.
Prices are bonus/split-adjusted; cash dividends are not included.
Trained on KMI-30 history only; results may not carry over to other stocks.
